title: Firebrand
features: This script will give the firebrand in any game
script:
-- This is a server-side script and should be placed in ServerScriptService.

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")
local gearId = 81154592 -- Firebrand

-- Wait for a player to join
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	-- Get the gear from ServerStorage
	local firebrand = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Firebrand")

	if firebrand then
		-- Clone the gear and give it to the player
		local clonedFirebrand = firebrand:Clone()
		clonedFirebrand.Parent = player.Backpack
	end
end)
